whatThisIs: A narrow local override for Casper Municipal Court, and a fence around it. Casper is the only publicly identified Wyoming local-form exception; this record exists so the exception cannot spread.

bindingLimits.why: A municipal court's forms govern that municipal court. Promoting them to a circuit or district court, or to statewide use, would put the wrong document in the wrong forum — and Natrona County is exactly where that mistake is easiest to make, because Casper sits in it.
bindingLimits.resolverGuard: No statewide Wyoming component may select a Casper packet, and no Casper packet may satisfy a statewide primary-filing component.

reproductionPermission.owner: the ordinary source and authorization lifecycle
reproductionPermission.note: Whether LegalEase may reproduce or prefill these local forms is determined the same way as any other publisher's forms: identity, currentness, licence. Public availability is not permission, and the statewide project-owner attestations do not reach a municipal publisher's forms.
reproductionPermission.untilResolved: The statewide custom-pleading packet remains the default everywhere outside the exact Casper local-form scope.

effectOnTheStatewidePacket: None. The statewide core packet is unchanged by the existence of this exception, and does not wait on it.
